# T-3: Defer exhausted draft semantic findings

<!-- Auto-generated by `senti spec render` from spec.json.tasks[]. Do not edit manually. -->

## Goal
Preserve draft-gate semantic exhaustion as a deferred planning finding instead of an implementation repair-proof blocker.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Validated typed draft semantic findings defer without repair evidence.
- Invalid source-artifact schema and non-semantic draft failures remain blocking.
- Deferred findings use the existing flow-findings artifact lifecycle.

## Implementation Notes
Classify draft findings after structural validation and before implementation-only proof evaluation. The audited preimplementation-bootstrap recovery is intentionally single-purpose: when existing implementation-target changes precede scenario validity, it records those exact paths, skips only scenario-validity and test-review, and retains test-execute, integration gate, and final-regression verification.

## Test Strategy
Focused retry-exhaustion tests cover draft semantic deferral and existing blocking classifications.
